piece.caption:
How to use Google Gemini computer use on Mac for business desktop tasks.

If you spend hours organizing downloaded PDF invoices, updating Excel sheets, or filling online forms across browser windows, AI computer agents are moving to the desktop. Google announced computer use for the Gemini desktop app on macOS. It operates inside a live preview background window, meaning your screen and mouse cursor stay completely free while it runs multi-step tasks.

You retain control to pause, stop, or approve actions before execution. However, this initial rollout is limited to English in the US and requires a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.

piece.dm_text:
Google Gemini Mac Computer Use updates:

1. Background Execution: Runs multi-step tasks across local files, apps, and web in a live preview chat window without locking your cursor.
2. Manual Control: Pause, stop, or approve actions before execution, and manage which apps Gemini accesses.
3. Capabilities: Form filling, sorting batch files into folders, making slideshows from dashboard files.
4. Requirements: Gemini Mac app, US English language setting, and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.
5. Source report: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/google-gives-gemini-the-ability-to-use-your-mac-for-you/

issues: Practical utility mismatch: The hook tells Indian business owners to stop doing manual invoice entry, implying they can use this solution right now. However, the feature is limited to US English users on Mac with a paid Google AI subscription, meaning Indian SMB owners cannot implement this today.
Hardware relevance: Most Indian SMB accounting and Excel work happens on Windows machines, whereas this specific feature is exclusively available on macOS.
review.fix_instructions: Reframe the hook and intro from an immediate tutorial ('Excel entry karna band karo') to a feature update preview ('Mac users ke liye Gemini ka bada update aaya hai'). Clarify early in scene 1 or 2 that this is a US-only rollout preview for Mac users so viewers do not expect immediate setup steps in India.

URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/google-gives-gemini-the-ability-to-use-your-mac-for-you/
Image Credits: Google AI Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you Sarah Perez 10:09 AM PST · November 19, 2026 Google on Thursday announced that it is bringing computer use to its Gemini desktop application on macOS, allowing its AI to complete tasks on users’ behalf, navigating native Mac apps, and browsing websites in the background.
The tech giant is a little late to the game with this launch, as other leading AI model makers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta have already been offering agentic features in their desktop applications for some time. Meanwhile, Google only this week announced the broader rollout of Gemini’s “Tasks,” the in-app feature that allows the AI to work more as an agent, helping users sign into websites, make online purchases, or book appointments.
Google also only recently began admitting early testers to try its revamped “CC” AI agent, announced in September , which is designed to help families stay organized across email, calendars, chats, and tasks.
Computer use is another type of agentic offering that allows an AI agent to take actions directly on the user’s computer — in Gemini’s case, a Mac. This allows the AI to complete multistep tasks that involve getting things done across local files, apps, and the web. After the user instructs the AI what they want to do, they’ll see the agent working in a live preview in their chat, while still keeping their screen and cursor free to continue working on other things.
As with other AI agents offering computer use, users can pause, stop, and approve Gemini’s actions before they happen.
Google suggests the feature could be useful for tedious tasks and other workflows, like filling out forms, repeating the same task over and over across a batch of files, organizing files into folders based on specific criteria, creating slideshows from files or information in online dashboards, and more.
The feature is initially available in English in the U.S. and requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription. The company didn’t say when it would expand to other markets or platforms.

Jay Peters Nov 19, 2026, 6:21 PM UTC Link
Jay Peters is a senior reporter covering technology, gaming, and more. He joined The Verge in 2019 after nearly two years at Techmeme. Google’s Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you “get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web,” the company says . Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale.
Users will be able to decide which of your apps Gemini can access, and be able to follow along as Gemini works because it has its own background window that shows a live preview in your chat, Google says. The feature is rolling out now in English for users in the US.
Gemini is introducing the new feature ahead of Apple launching new restrictions for apps wanting “full disk access” on Mac due to potential risks from AI agents with computer use. A preview of the settings rolled out with this week’s macOS 27.3 beta .
